neighbours.label: ' feel' as an opinion verb ('we feel that', 'that I feel good about', 'they feel will save them')
fire: At our firm, we feel that training is vital.
I buy gifts that I feel good about giving.
People join groups that they feel will help them.
As a school, we feel that reading comes first.
I pick books that I feel my kids will love.
Voters back leaders who they feel will listen.
Here at the clinic, we feel that care matters.
She chose a plan that she felt would work.
quiet: At our firm, we sell tools and paint.
I buy gifts from the small shop.
People join groups in the spring.
As a school, we open at eight.
I pick books from the top shelf.
Voters met leaders at the town hall.
Here at the clinic, we close at five.
She chose a plan from the list.
